name: fyi-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server for FYI request management
long_description: A native MCP server for managing FYI official information requests. It exposes the request, authority, and correspondence workflows through the standard MCP tool interface.

tools.name: list_requests
tools.description: List tracked Alaveteli requests from the database

tools.name: retrieve_request
tools.description: Retrieve an Alaveteli request and its correspondence by ID

tools.name: create_request
tools.description: Create a new request in the database

tools.name: update_request
tools.description: Update an existing request in the database

tools.name: delete_request
tools.description: Delete a request and its correspondence from the database

tools.name: list_authorities
tools.description: List authorities stored in the database

tools.name: import_authorities
tools.description: Import or update authorities in the database

tools.name: sync_monitor
tools.description: Show sync status, queue depth, and latest sync time

tools.name: sync_conflicts
tools.description: List requests currently marked as sync conflicts

tools.name: sync_resolve_conflict
tools.description: Resolve a sync conflict as clean or dirty

tools.name: sync_status
tools.description: Read offline synchronization status globally or for one request

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Check database status and other components
